snippet.title: One Bad Roll. One Less Finger. | Cut and Dice Trailer
snippet.description:
ADD TO WISHLIST ON STEAM

You can try the demo version on Steam.

CUT AND DICE is a grim indie game with dark humor, where a single dice roll costs you a finger. You and your opponent sit at the table. Roll the dice.
